value.rationale: A sharp singularity in the ability to move between all optimum k-connected dominating backbones is a natural solution-space property rather than a standard numerical bound. The proof gives complete state-graph structure in the n<2k regime, exact isolation count at \(n=2k\), connectedness and degree for n>2k, plus exact bivariate feasibility counts for every allowed pair \((n,k)\). This resolves a motivated optimization-reconfiguration question for an infinite two-parameter graph family.
